note: SAMPLE 5 sound timeline (stage 2a, frozen after hand-back). Part A = v4 scene 3 (customs desk, with Noakes), Part B = v4 scene 13 (outer rim, cannonball). Built by production/tools/toon/build_sample5.py.

dialogue.text: Next.
dialogue.business: Mira, not looking up, stamping papers

dialogue.text: There's no one else here.
dialogue.business: Jax: open-hand sweep at the empty benches

dialogue.text: It's procedure. Next.
dialogue.business: Mira stamps something, patient; eyes still down

dialogue.text: Parcel, one. Sealed. Addressed to a district withdrawn at fourteen-oh-two. Seized at fourteen-nineteen.
dialogue.business: Mira O.S., reading quick and dry; Jax arrives and sets his elbow on the counter on 'Seized'

dialogue.text: Here's my situation. My aunt—
dialogue.business: Jax: elbow on counter, full charm, leans in

dialogue.text: You don't have an aunt.
dialogue.business: Mira: flat, one brow down; doesn't look up from the form

dialogue.text: You don't know that.
dialogue.business: Jax: a wounded finger-point at her

dialogue.text: Your form says next of kin: none.
dialogue.business: Mira holds up his own form, taps the line

dialogue.text: She's very distant. Look — I can tell you're someone who appreciates flexibility.
dialogue.business: Jax: 'very distant' — points far off without a blink; 'Look—' leans in confidential

dialogue.text: Then you'll appreciate the Lunar Courier Exemption. Section twelve.
dialogue.business: Jax: finger up, 'Section twelve' with a little flourish

dialogue.text: There are nine sections.
dialogue.business: Mira: deadpan, looks at him over the form

dialogue.text: Which is why twelve is so exclusive.
dialogue.business: Jax: confidential half-whisper, eyebrows

dialogue.text: Your record starts seven years ago.
dialogue.business: Mira, slower; eyes come up to him

dialogue.text: Late bloomer.
dialogue.business: Jax: shrug, easy grin

dialogue.text: Your record isn't late, Captain. It's blank.
dialogue.business: Mira: quiet, holding his look

dialogue.text: Holding bay.
dialogue.business: Mira: brisk, back to business

dialogue.text: You were struck off for saying the map was wrong. Please don't get struck off again for saying it louder.
dialogue.business: Noakes: soft, pained

dialogue.text: It is wrong.
dialogue.business: Mira: doesn't turn round

dialogue.text: It's official. Those aren't opposites, Doctor Sen. They're departments.
dialogue.business: Noakes: kindly, as if to a child

dialogue.text: One more complaint and your probation ends. Let nothing happen. One more day.
dialogue.business: Noakes: a prayer, eyes on the board

dialogue.text: I used to be taller!
dialogue.business: BUTTON: the Baron, distant, outraged, echoing

dialogue.text: There it is. Here it doesn't rise. It waits, low, like a dog at a door.
dialogue.business: Baron: gentle, looking at Earth

dialogue.text: Sign, Captain.
dialogue.business: Baron: plainly, turning to Jax

dialogue.text: You'd be a show. Four times a day.
dialogue.business: Jax: flat, eyes on Earth

dialogue.text: A tidy Baron is still a Baron. A thin one is a coat on a chair.
dialogue.business: Baron: patient

dialogue.text: I have seen the thin ones. They sit in waiting rooms and cannot remember what they are waiting for.
dialogue.business: Baron: the thin ones in waiting rooms (v3 stem of the v4 beat)

dialogue.text: Tell me one.
dialogue.business: Jax: 'Tell me one.'

dialogue.text: Ochakov. The Turks had the fortress. We had the field. The general wanted to know how many guns were inside.
dialogue.business: Baron: Ochakov — hands begin to draw the fortress in the air

dialogue.text: So I stood by our biggest cannon, and when it fired, I jumped on the ball.
dialogue.business: Baron: '...and when it fired, I jumped on the ball' — CUTAWAY starts on 'when it fired'

dialogue.text: On it.
dialogue.business: Jax V.O., laughing already (stays on cutaway)

dialogue.text: Astride. Like a horse, but rounder.
dialogue.business: Baron V.O., deadly serious: astride, like a horse but rounder (cutaway: riding pose)

dialogue.text: Halfway across, I had doubts. I am not ashamed of doubts. If I land in there, they will hang me for a spy.
dialogue.business: Baron V.O.: doubts (cutaway: he looks down at the fortress, gallows sketch in a thought)

dialogue.text: So when a ball came past from their side, going the other way — I changed.
dialogue.business: Baron V.O.: 'when a ball came past from their side' (cutaway: the other ball approaches) — 'I changed' (the swap)

dialogue.text: You changed cannonballs.
dialogue.business: Jax

dialogue.text: In mid-air. And rode it home. Earth says I rode one there and back.
dialogue.business: Baron: 'In mid-air. And rode it home.' (2 s cutaway insert: riding the second ball home) 'Earth says I rode one there and back.'

dialogue.text: I rode it there. Back, I took a different cannonball.
dialogue.business: Baron: the punchline, a tiny bow of the helmet

dialogue.text: (laughs)
dialogue.business: Jax laughs in spite of himself (NEW Kokoro line, needs listening)

dialogue.text: There. You listened to the end. Do you know how rare that is?
dialogue.business: Baron: quiet, pleased

dialogue.text: Did it happen?
dialogue.business: Jax: still smiling

dialogue.text: It's happening now. You are the audience.
dialogue.business: Baron: simply

dialogue.text: If ever you need me — truly — I will come. By cannonball. It is undignified and very fast.
dialogue.business: Baron: the promise

dialogue.text: You lie well, Captain.
dialogue.business: Baron: warm

dialogue.text: Thanks.
dialogue.business: Jax: light

dialogue.text: You lie like a man who once had to lie for his life.
dialogue.business: Baron
